UFO researcher Lue Elizondo reportedly revealed unusual activities on the Moon and said that it might have a connection with unexplained NASA footage. Lue said,

"There's a lot of information in the data that suggests that there may be some very interesting features on there that require further exploration and understanding."

Lue admitted that he had never traveled to the moon but explained that he possessed a large amount of knowledge gathered from data. He further stated that these data require deeper study and more exploration.

Lue mentioned that NASA reported for decades that they had no indication of life in the solar system other than Earth. He also explained that NASA astronauts had never encountered anything unique related to UAP, and such encounters couldn't be properly explained with photographic or video evidence.

The researcher explained that the documents came directly from NASA, along with interviews of astronauts describing unusual things they saw in space. He added that there were also videos showing NASA capturing objects and photographs taken from the lunar surface of things moving in orbit around the moon.

Continue reading more about the UFO files.

The UFO files updates: Elizondo linked lunar oddities to mysterious NASA footage

Elizondo reminded us that for decades NASA insisted there was absolutely no indication of life in the solar system, and the astronauts never saw anything unusual. However, he pointed to recent disclosures:

"What happened two and a half months ago during the first and second tranche release of information? You had none other than NASA documents themselves, interviews with NASA astronauts of seeing strange things up there, video of NASA capturing things up there, and photographs taken from where? From the surface of the moon, the lunar surface of objects in a lunar orbit."

He stressed that the technology in lunar orbit at that time was only the orbiter waiting for the lander, yet NASA admitted that what they were seeing didn't match that.

According to Elizondo, this means the objects could be real. He said that after 60 years of denial, NASA finally admitted there seems to be something out there and acknowledged they hadn't been completely truthful.

Elizondo:

"NASA, after, what, 60 years of denial, has come out and said, yeah, looks like there is stuff. And we weren't completely truthful with you. That's a big step. That's a big step."

The researcher said that other government agencies are paying close attention to how the public reacts and further mentioned old rumors about NASA 'editing photos' and wondered why such things were kept secret.

The UFO files updates: A mysterious hole on the Moon is still unknown to NASA scientists

According to Metro, NASA is studying a wide underground cave that may stretch beyond the Marius Hill Pit. It is a large opening in one of the moon's most volcanically active regions.

Scientists explained that such a cave could serve as a shelter for astronauts and protect them from harmful radiation and the extreme changes in temperature on the lunar surface.

In Podcast UFO Live Shows, Elizondo imagined what it might have been like for NASA during the Cold War. If unusual pictures came in, the administrator would have to report them to the president. Elizondo explained that the challenge would come when the president would ask if they really knew what the object was, and the honest answer would be that they weren't sure.
